<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU3"></a><font style="font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Unless the context requires otherwise, references in this Form 10-K to the </font><font style="font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8220;Company,&#8221; &#8220;Iconix,&#8221; &#8220;we,&#8221; &#8220;us,&#8221; &#8220;our,&#8221; or similar pronouns refer to Iconix Brand Group, Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries.</font></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="PART_I"></a><font style="font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="PART_I"></a>PART</font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> I</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="ITEM_1_BUSINESS"></a><a name="ITEM_1_BUSINESS"></a>Item&#160;1. Business</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">General</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Iconix Brand Group is a brand management company and owner of a diversified portfolio of approximately 30 global consumer brands across the women&#8217;s, men&#8217;s, home and international segments. The Company&#8217;s business strategy is to maximize the value of its brands primarily through strategic licenses and joint venture partnerships around the world, as well as to grow the portfolio of brands through strategic acquisitions.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">As of December&#160;31, 2019, the Company&#8217;s brand portfolio includes Candie&#8217;s <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Bongo <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Joe Boxer <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Rampage <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Mudd <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, London Fog <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Mossimo <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Ocean Pacific/OP <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Danskin/Danskin Now <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Rocawear <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Cannon <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Royal Velvet <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Fieldcrest <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Charisma <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Starter <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Waverly <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Ecko Unltd <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> /Mark Ecko Cut&#160;&amp; Sew <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Zoo&#160;York <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Umbro <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Lee Cooper <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, and Artful Dodger <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>; and interests in Material Girl <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Ed Hardy <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Truth or Dare <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Modern Amusement <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Buffalo <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Hydraulic <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, and PONY <sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company principally looks to monetize the Intellectual Property (&#8220;IP&#8221;) related to its brands throughout the world and in all relevant categories primarily by licensing directly with leading retailers (&#8220;direct to retail&#8221; or &#8220;DTR&#8221;), through consortia of wholesale licensees, through joint ventures in specific territories and via other activity such as corporate sponsorships and content as well as the sale of IP for specific categories or territories. Products bearing the Company&#8217;s brands are sold across a variety of distribution channels. The licensees are generally responsible for designing, manufacturing and distributing the licensed products.&#160;The Company&#160;supports its&#160;brands with marketing, advertising and promotional campaigns designed to increase brand awareness. Additionally, the Company provides its licensees with coordinated trend direction to enhance product appeal and help build and maintain brand integrity.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Globally, the Company has over 70 DTR licenses and more than 430 total licenses. Licensees are selected based upon the Company&#8217;s belief that such licensees will be able to produce and sell quality products in the categories and distribution channels of their specific expertise and that they are capable of exceeding minimum sales targets and royalties that the Company generally requires for each brand. This licensing strategy is designed to permit the Company to operate its licensing business, leverage its core competencies of marketing and brand management with minimal working capital. The majority of the Company&#8217;s licensing agreements include minimum guaranteed royalty revenue which provides the Company with greater visibility into future cash flows. As of January&#160;1, 2020, the Company had approximately $400 million of aggregate guaranteed royalty revenue over the terms of its existing contracts excluding renewals. </p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In the past, a key initiative in the Company&#8217;s global brand expansion plans was the formation of international joint ventures. The strategy in forming international joint ventures is to partner with best-in-class, local partners to bring the Company&#8217;s brands to market more quickly and efficiently, generating greater short- and long-term value from its IP, than the Company believes is possible if it were to build-out wholly-owned operations ourselves across a multitude of regional or local offices. Since September 2008, the Company has established the following international joint ventures: Iconix China, Iconix Latin America, Iconix Europe, Iconix India, Iconix Canada, Iconix Australia, Iconix Southeast Asia, Iconix Israel, Iconix Middle East, Umbro China, Danskin China, Starter China, and Lee Cooper China.&nbsp;&nbsp;Note that the Company now maintains a 100% ownership interest in Iconix China, Iconix Latin America, Iconix Canada and Umbro China.&nbsp;&nbsp;Refer to Note 4 in Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements for further detail. </p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company&#8217;s primary goal of maximizing the value of its IP also includes, in certain instances, the sale to third parties of a brand&#8217;s trademark in specific territories or categories. As such, the Company evaluates potential offers to acquire some or all of a brand&#8217;s IP by comparing whether the offer is more valuable than the Company&#8217;s estimate of the current and potential revenue streams to be earned via the Company&#8217;s traditional licensing model. Further, as part of the Company&#8217;s evaluation process it also considers whether or not the buyer&#8217;s future development of the brand may help to expand the brand&#8217;s overall recognition and global revenue potential.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">1</a></p>

<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company owns a diversified portfolio of approximately 30 iconic brands across the Company&#8217;s four operating segments: women&#8217;s, men&#8217;s, home, and international (see Note 17 in Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements). The Company&#8217;s objective is to grow its&#160;existing portfolio organically, both domestically and internationally, and&#160;acquire new brands, both of which leverage its brand&#160;management expertise,&#160;platform and infrastructure, and&#160;where third parties offer similar leverage of their relationships and&#160;infrastructures, enter&#160;into joint ventures or other&#160;partnerships.&#160;To achieve this objective, the Company intends to:</p>

<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In managing its brands, the Company seeks to capitalize on its heritage and authenticity, while simultaneously working to keep its brands relevant to today&#8217;s consumer.</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_Hlk534723894"></a>Women&#8217;s</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Brands Wholly Owned by Iconix:</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Candie&#8217;s.<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">&#160;</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">Candie&#8217;s is known as a &#8220;fun &amp; flirty&#8221; young contemporary lifestyle brand, featuring products in apparel, accessories and footwear categories. As Iconix&#8217;s longest held trademark, Candie&#8217;s brand was established in 1977 which started with a high-heeled wooden-sole slide shoe that allowed women to put a punctuation mark on their look. Since then, the Candie&#8217;s brand has popped with cultural connection reflecting the attitude and aspiration of the times. In July 2005, Kohl&#8217;s Department Stores, Inc., became the primary DTR licensee with a multi-category line of Candie&#8217;s products, including sportswear, denim, footwear, handbags and intimate apparel. The agreement with Kohl&#8217;s will expire under its terms on January 31, 2021. The brand has signed wholesale license agreements with channels outside of Kohl&#8217;s within optical, fragrance, and girl&#8217;s underwear and sleepwear categories of business. Candie&#8217;s award-winning advertising is known for its flirty but playful concepts. Over the years the brand has created omni-channel marketing campaigns leveraging its talent of &#8220;It&#8221; girls including Britney Spears, Fergie, Destiny&#8217;s Child, Lea Michele, Vanessa Hudgens, Hilary Duff, Bella Thorne, Kelly Clarkson, Jenny McCarthy and Sarah Hyland. </font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Mudd.<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> Mudd is a highly recognizable junior lifestyle brand representing a generation of independent girls who stand up, stand out, and make their dreams a reality.&nbsp;&nbsp;It was established in 1995 and acquired by Iconix in April 2006. Mudd has since become a junior&#8217;s denim destination synonymous with feminine-yet-casual fashion and a free-spirited lifestyle. In November 2008, the Mudd brand entered into a multi-year, exclusive, DTR licensing agreement with Kohl&#8217;s Department Stores, Inc., across the United States for apparel, footwear, fashion accessories and jewelry which will expire under its terms on January 31, 2021.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Danskin/Danskin Now.<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> Danskin is a 135 year-old iconic brand of women&#8217;s activewear, athleisure, legwear, dancewear, intimates, sleepwear, and fitness equipment, which the Company acquired in March 2007. Danskin has maintained a legacy of health, strength and female empowerment in its core values. The Danskin brand continues to be sold through better department, mid-tier, specialty and sporting goods stores, as well as through Danskin.com by wholesale licensees in the United States. In 2014, the brand re-launched its e-commerce site, blog, and expanded its social media efforts sustaining its heritage with dance.&nbsp;&nbsp; As previously disclosed, the Company&#8217;s DTR with Wal-mart expired under its terms in January 2019.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Danskin brand has seven licensees including a new addition of Footwear for 2019.&nbsp;&nbsp;Even after the termination of the Wal-mart retail license agreement, we believe the brand has a solid distribution of retailers.&nbsp;&nbsp;These retailers include Amazon, Costco, and Walmart.com as well as a strong presence within TJX corporation. </font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Mossimo.<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> Mossimo is known as a contemporary, active and youthful lifestyle brand.&nbsp;&nbsp;The brand was established in 1986 and acquired by the Company in October 2006. From 2000 to October 2018, Target Corporation, (&#8220;Target&#8221;), had held the exclusive license in the United States, covering apparel products for men, women and children, including casual sportswear, denim, swimwear, bodywear, watches, handbags and other fashion accessories and had become one of the largest apparel brands in the United States.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;We are in the process of developing a &#8220;go forward&#8221; strategy to position the brand in mid-range retailers, off price retailers and on-line retailers in an effort to transfer the name of the brand developed over the years with the consumer.&nbsp;&nbsp;Our 2020 focus is to secure strong licensee partners to design, develop and distribute a variety of product categories to a wider base of retailers.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Joe Boxer.<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> Joe Boxer is a highly recognized lifestyle brand known for its irreverent and humorous image and provocative promotional events. Acquired by Iconix in July 2005, the brand was established in 1985 with the idea of taking basic clothing and re-imagining it to reflect humor, fashion and popular trends. The Company entered into a non-exclusive agreement for the brand with Kmart/Sears in February 2019.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">4</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">London Fog.</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> London Fog is a classic brand known worldwide for its outerwear, luggage and travel products, cold weather accessories, umbrellas and footwear. The brand was established over 80 years ago and was acquired by the Company in August 2006. The brand is sold i</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">n a variety of categories through wholesale licenses in the United&#160;States, primarily through the department store </font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">and club </font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">channel</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">s </font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">including Macy&#8217;s</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">,</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> Nordstrom&#8217;s </font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">and Sam&#8217;s Club</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">. Further, the Company has a </font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">DTR</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> license agreement for London Fog with Hudson&#8217;s </font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">Bay Corporation in Canada.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Rampage.<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> Rampage was established in 1982 and is known as a young contemporary fashion brand that empowers women to be their truest, boldest selves. Rampage was acquired by Iconix in September 2005 with products sold through better department stores such as Macy&#8217;s and Belk Stores across categories of footwear, handbags, intimates, accessories and outerwear. Previous campaigns have featured Petra Nemcova, Gisele B&#252;ndchen, Bar Refaeli, Irina Shayk, and Olivia Culpo.&nbsp;&nbsp;In 2019, the Company named reality television star Savannah Chrisley as the Creative Director for the brand.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Ocean Pacific/OP.<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> Ocean Pacific and OP are global action-sports lifestyle apparel brands which trace their heritage to Ocean Pacific&#8217;s roots as a 1960&#8217;s surfboard label. The Company acquired the Ocean Pacific/OP brands in November 2006.&nbsp;&nbsp;In 2017, Ocean Pacific was repositioned to re-connect with the brand heritage and its authentic core customer, the action-sports enthusiast, across the specialty, department store off-price channels in all categories and genders including swim, apparel, accessories, home and beach related products.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Bongo.<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> The Bongo brand is a California lifestyle brand established in 1982 and is best described as the everyday girl with a splash of cool.&nbsp;&nbsp;Recognized for its famous denim fit, Bongo also features a broad range of Junior&#8217;s casual apparel and accessories, including sportswear, eyewear and footwear. The Company is exploring opportunities to license the brand to new or existing licensees.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Brands Held by Iconix with Joint Venture Partners: </p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">MG Icon&#8212;Material Girl.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">Material Girl is designed to fit into the &#8220;it&#8221; woman&#8217;s demanding, multi-dimensional world.&nbsp;&nbsp;Material Girl offers the millennial customer fast fashion at affordable prices and is the go-to for style setters.&nbsp;&nbsp;MG Icon, a joint venture in which the Company has a 50% interest, was created by Iconix with Madonna and Guy Oseary in March 2010 to buy, create, develop and license the Material Girl brand across a spectrum of consumer product categories.&nbsp;&nbsp;Concurrent with the formation of this joint venture, MG Icon entered a DTR exclusive license with Macy&#8217;s Retail Holdings, Inc. (&#8220;Macy&#8217;s&#8221;) covering a wide array of consumer categories across the Material Girl brand. As previously disclosed, the license agreement expired under its terms in January 2020.&nbsp;&nbsp;The brand has wholesale license agreements in hosiery and socks and will transition the apparel, intimates and sleepwear products to new partners.&nbsp;&nbsp;Celebrating its tenth year, the brand has had many notable faces for its campaigns, including Rita Ora, Zendaya, Kelly Osbourne, Sofia Richie, Taylor Momsen, Pia Mia, and Serayah.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Men&#8217;s</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Brands Wholly-Owned by Iconix:</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Rocawear.<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> Rocawear is a youth culture brand, established by Shawn &#8220;Jay-Z&#8221; Carter and his partners in 1999. The Company acquired the Rocawear brand in March 2007. Rocawear is currently licensed in the United States in a variety of categories, including men&#8217;s, women&#8217;s and kids&#8217; apparel, outerwear, footwear, jewelry and handbags. Rocawear products are sold primarily through department and specialty stores.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Starter.<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> Founded in 1971, Starter is one of the original brands in licensed team sports merchandise and is a highly recognized brand of athletic apparel and footwear. The Company acquired Starter in December 2007.&#160;The Starter brand has been worn by some of the greatest athletes in MLB, NBA, NFL and NHL. Most recently, the Company has partnered with all the major professional sports leagues and over one hundred NCAA universities throughout the U.S. through a licensee to re-launch the iconic Starter satin jacket, sold through various specialty stores, sporting goods stores and online. In 2012, the Starter Black brand was launched.&nbsp;&nbsp;Starter Black is a premium lifestyle brand extension that focuses on a fashion-forward collection of logo branded apparel and accessories and has quickly become a staple among celebrities, athletes and influencers.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Starter Black brand is sold in high-end specialty and sporting goods stores (e.g. Fanatics, Barnes and Noble College Book Stores).&nbsp;&nbsp;In the Fall of 2017, the Starter brand was launched as an exclusive distribution with Amazon as their only national brand in their private brand division.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Zoo York.<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">&#160;Zoo York is an East Coast-based action lifestyle brand, named for the graffiti-art infused counterculture of 1970&#8217;s New York City.&#160;Zoo York has licenses with wholesalers covering a variety of products, including men&#8217;s, women&#8217;s and kids&#8217; apparel, footwear, socks and accessories.&#160;The Manhattan-based brand proudly serves up a wide range of casual utilitarian looks for men and women that fuse authentic military-influenced overtones with iconic Zoo York City imagery.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company acquired a 51% interest in the Zoo&#160;York brand as part of the Ecko Untld. acquisition in 2009, and the Company increased its ownership to 100% in 2011.&#160;Zoo York is currently distributed in department and specialty stores including Zumiez.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">5</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Ecko Unltd, Marc Ecko Cut&#160;&amp; Sew.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">In October 2009, the Company, through a then newly formed joint venture c</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">ompany IPH Unltd, acquired a 51% controlling stake in the Ecko portfolio of brands. In May 2013, the Company purchased the remaining 49% interest from its minority partner, increasing its ownership in IPH Unltd from 51% to 100%.&#160;Founded in 1993, Ecko and i</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">ts various brands are marketed and sold to consumers in the youth culture lifestyle categories, including active-athletic, streetwear, collegiate/preppy and denim fashion for men, women and children. Ecko Unltd. products are sold primarily through departme</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">nt and specialty stores including Dillard&#8217;s and </font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">BJ&#8217;s</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">. Ecko Unltd. brand ambassadors include professional skateboarder Manny Santiago and professional boxer Danny Garcia.&#160; Marc Ecko Cut&#160;&amp; Sew is a halo brand, licensed in men&#8217;s apparel, outerwear, underwear,</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> fragrance and accessories.&#160;It is distributed in boutiques, specialty stores and Dillard&#8217;s Department Store.&#160;</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Artful Dodger.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">In November 2007, Scion, through its wholly-owned subsidiary, Artful Holdings LLC, purchased the Artful Dodger brand, a high end urban apparel brand.&nbsp;&nbsp;In July 2015, the Company acquired the remaining 50% interest in the Scion joint venture which increased the Company&#8217;s ownership interest in Scion, and as a result, Artful Dodger, to 100%.</font> </p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Umbro.<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> Founded in 1924, Umbro is a global football (soccer) brand. The brand combines British heritage with a modern football lifestyle to create iconic sports apparel and footwear with high global awareness and strong global distribution. The Company acquired the Umbro brand in November 2012. The Company and its licensees sponsor more than a hundred national and professional teams worldwide. Umbro products are sold globally through a strong network of licensees and partners in the United States, Canada, Australia, Africa, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, India and Latin America. </font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Lee Cooper.<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> Founded in 1908, Lee Cooper is an iconic British denim brand that has expanded into multiple lifestyle categories including men&#8217;s, women&#8217;s and kids&#8217; casual wear, footwear and accessories. The Company acquired the Lee Cooper brand in February&#160;2013. Lee Cooper has global reach through more than 40 licensees with product sold in Africa, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, India and Latin America. </font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Hydraulic IP Holdings, LLC - Hydraulic.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">In December 2014, the Company formed a joint venture with Top On International Group Limited in which the Company effectively purchased a 51% interest in the Hydraulic trademarks and related assets. </font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#000000;">In April 2018, the Company acquired the remaining 49% ownership interest from its joint venture partner.&nbsp;&nbsp;This transaction resulted in the Company effectively increasing its ownership interest in Hydraulic to 100%. </font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">Hydraulic was founded in New York in 1998 and is known for setting the blue jean standard. Hydraulic differentiates itself from other denim brands by positioning itself with the theme that all denim was not created equally. Hydraulic is currently distributed in specialty and off-price retailers and is licensed for women&#8217;s apparel in the United States.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Brands Held by Iconix with Joint Venture Partners:</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Hardy Way-Ed Hardy.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">In May 2009, the Company acquired a 50% interest in Hardy Way, the owner of the Ed Hardy brand and trademarks.&#160;In April 2011, the Company made an additional investment in Hardy Way which effectively increased its ownership interest to 85%. Don Ed Hardy and his artwork date back to 1967 when he transformed the tattoo business into an artistic medium. He began licensing his name and artwork for apparel in 2003 and today the Ed&#160;Hardy brand is recognized by its tattoo inspired lifestyle products. The brand is licensed to wholesalers in the United States for men&#8217;s, women&#8217;s, and kids&#8217; apparel, fragrance, footwear and accessories. Distribution in the United States includes a wide base of retail stores, from Fred Segal to Walmart. Celebrities that have worn the brand include Shakira, Lil Wayne, Madonna, Dwight Howard, Jessica Alba and Eva Longoria. </font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Icon Modern Amusement&#8212;Modern Amusement.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">In December 2012, the Company entered into an agreement with Dirty Bird Productions, Inc., in which the Company purchased a 51% interest in the Modern Amusement trademarks and related assets. Modern Amusement is a premium, west coast-lifestyle brand with a focus on casual sportswear apparel and related accessories for young men and young women. Modern Amusement has a DTR license in the U.S. with PacSun which distributes men&#8217;s apparel and footwear. </font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Buffalo Brand Joint Venture&#8212;Buffalo by David Bitton.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">In February 2013, the Company formed a joint venture with Buffalo International ULC in which the Company effectively purchased a 51% interest in the Buffalo trademarks and related assets. Founded in 1985, Buffalo is a lifestyle brand consisting of denim, sportswear, active wear, and accessories. Buffalo is sold primarily through better department and club stores.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">US Pony Holdings, LLC &#8211; Pony / Product of New York.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">In February&#160;2015, the Company through its newly formed subsidiary, US Pony Holdings, LLC, acquired the North American rights to the Pony / Product of New York brand. These rights include the rights in the United States obtained from Pony, Inc. and Pony International, LLC, and the rights in Mexico and Canada obtained from Super Jumbo Holdings Limited. US Pony Holdings, LLC is owned 75% by the Company and 25% by its partner, Anthony L&amp;S Athletics, LLC. Formed in 1972 in&#160;New York City, PONY became one of the top athletic footwear brands worldwide in the 1990&#8217;s appearing on professional athletes in the NBA,&#160;NFL, MLB, Pro Soccer, Pro Tennis, and Pro Boxing.&nbsp;&nbsp;Since acquiring the brand, the Company has entered into footwear, apparel and hosiery licensing contracts.&nbsp;&nbsp;The brand is distributed in mid-tier department stores, specialty stores and sporting goods stores and Pony.com.</font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">6</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Home</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Brands Wholly-Owned by Iconix:</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Cannon.<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> </font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#000000;">Established in 1887, Cannon is a brand with a powerful heritage and products that are known for their high quality, easy care and appeal to a broad range of consumers.&nbsp;&nbsp;One of the most recognized home brands, Cannon delivers a consistent quality at an affordable price.&nbsp;&nbsp;It is known as the first textile brand to sew logos onto products.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company acquired Cannon in 2007.&nbsp;&nbsp;In October 2018, the Company entered into a non-exclusive license agreement for the brand with Kmart/Sears.&nbsp;&nbsp;In March 2019, the Company signed two new licensing agreements for Cannon with Pem America and Blue Ridge Home fashions in various product categories.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Pem America license agreement covers the US, Canadian and Mexican markets and Blue Ridge Home Fashions covers the US and Canadian markets. In 2019, the Company entered a DTR with Ollies for bath towels, bath rugs and accent rugs as well as a license agreement with Mainstream for bath towels and kitchen textiles. </font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Royal Velvet.<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> For over 60 years, Royal Velvet has been celebrating home fashions, offering sophisticated designs that foster creativity and welcome customers home. Royal Velvet is a premium brand that provides a sophisticated aesthetic to homes and delivers exceptional quality that people know, trust and love. Royal Velvet is an authority on color, bringing rich, elevated choices in home textiles and d&#233;cor.&nbsp;&nbsp; The Royal Velvet towel has been an industry standard since 1954. Royal Velvet products include towels, sheets, bath rugs, fashion bedding, basic bedding and window treatments.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company acquired Royal Velvet in 2007.&nbsp;&nbsp;In April 2011, the Company entered into an exclusive DTR license with JC Penney Corporation, Inc., for the Royal Velvet brand in the United States.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#000000;">As previously disclosed, the agreement expired under its terms in January 2019.  In March 2019, the Company entered into a license agreement with Himatsingka America, a part of the Himatsingka Group for various product categories within the US, Canada and Mexico markets.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company is also currently in negotiations for licensing of the brand to additional new or existing licensees.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Fieldcrest.<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> Fieldcrest has been the choice for quality bedding and bath since the late 19th Century. A brand rich in heritage, Fieldcrest is foundational luxury for the modern guest.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company acquired Fieldcrest in 2007. From 2005 until the agreement expired under its terms on January 31, 2020, the Fieldcrest brand had been licensed exclusively to Target in the United States. In 2019, the Company has entered into a license agreement with Keeco for all home textiles. </font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Charisma.<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> </font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#000000;">Charisma home textiles were introduced in the 1970&#8217;s and </font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#000000;">are synonymous with understated elegance.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#000000;">The Company acquired Charisma in 2007. In February 2009, the Company signed a DTR license with Costco Wholesale Corporation, (&#8220;Costco&#8221;) for certain Charisma products to be sold in Costco stores in the United States and other countries.&nbsp;&nbsp;In 2019, Costco extended the current contract for an additional three years. The brand is also licensed in the United States and Canada for distribution through better department stores such as Bloomingdales, Nieman Marcus and Macy&#8217;s, as well as Horchow, Bed Bath &amp; Beyond and QVC.</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> The Company is in conversations with various parties to expand the brand into new categories. </font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Waverly.<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> </font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#000000;">Waverly is a home fashion and lifestyle brand that has been a leader in prints and patterns since its launch in 1923. It is one of the most recognized names in home d&#233;cor and furnishings. Waverly&#8217;s distinctive color palette and accessible home decor allows consumers to mix and match fabrics offering a custom-designed look at an affordable price.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company acquired Waverly in October 2008.  Waverly has two DTR agreements in the United States: with Wal-Mart for the Waverly Inspirations Collection covering fabrics and craft, which Walmart extended in 2019 for two additional years, and with the Christmas Tree Shop for the Waverly Home Collection.&nbsp;&nbsp;Waverly also has wholesale licensees in the United States for products including fabric, window treatments, d&#233;cor, and bedding that are sold through retailers such as Jo-Ann&#8217;s, Lowe&#8217;s, JCPenny, Bed Bath and Beyond, and Belk, as well as specialty and off-price retailers.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Entertainment</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company completed the sale of its Entertainment segment on June 30, 2017 for $349.1 million in cash. The Entertainment segment was previously comprised of the Company&#8217;s interests in the intellectual property of the Peanuts, and Strawberry Shortcake brands.</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">International </p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Wholly-Owned Subsidiaries and Joint Ventures: </p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Within the international segment, the Company operates both wholly-owned subsidiaries and joint ventures in various territories.&nbsp;&nbsp;A variety of the Company&#8217;s brands are present within these territories and generate license revenue and profitability.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">7</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="text-decoration:underline;">Wholly-Owned Subsidiaries</font><font style="text-decoration:underline;font-style:normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Iconix China.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">In September 2008, the Company and Novel Fashions Holdings Limited (&#8220;Novel&#8221;), formed a joint venture, Iconix China, to develop, exploit and market the Company&#8217;s brands in the People&#8217;s Republic of China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan (together, &#8220;Greater China&#8221;).&#160;In the initial phase of the joint venture, Iconix China sought to maximize brand monetization through investment, whereby Iconix China received a minority equity stake in local operating companies in exchange for the rights to one or more of the Company&#8217;s brands in Greater China and brand management support. Pursuant to the terms of this transaction, the Company contributed to Iconix China substantially all rights to its brands in Greater China and contributed $2.0 million, and Novel contributed $17 million to Iconix China.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Iconix China successfully placed several brands into joint ventures including Candie&#8217;s and Marc Ecko Cut&#160;&amp; Sew with Shanghai La Chapelle Fashion Co. Ltd (HK 6116); London Fog with China Outfitters (HK1146); Material Girl with Ningbo Peacebird; Ed Hardy with Landmark International; and Ecko Unltd. with Xi Ha Clothing. These brands are collectively sold through more than 1,000 branded retail locations. In April 2016, the Company sold its interest in TangLi International, Ltd. (Ed Hardy China).&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In March 2015, the Company<font style="color:#000000;"> purchased all equity interests in Iconix China owned by its partner, increasing the Company&#8217;s ownership of Iconix China from 50% to 100%. Subsequently, the Company has secured traditional licensing agreements for many of its brands including Umbro, Joe Boxer, Rocawear, Rampage, Danskin and Starter. </font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Iconix Latin America.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">In December 2008, the Company formed a joint venture partnership (&#8220;Iconix Latin America&#8221;) with New Brands, an affiliate of the Falic Group, to develop, exploit, market and license the Company&#8217;s brands in the Latin American territory comprising of Mexico, Central America, South America and the Caribbean. In February 2014, the Company purchased from New Brands its 50% interest in Iconix Latin America for $42.0 million, increasing the Company&#8217;s ownership to 100%. Today, Iconix Latin America has over fifty licenses, including key DTR relationships with Falabella, Wal-Mart and Suburbia.&nbsp;&nbsp;Licensed brands in this territory include Candie&#8217;s, Joe Boxer, London Fog, Mossimo, Ocean Pacific, Danskin/Danskin Now, Starter, Zoo York, Ecko Unltd., Ed Hardy, Cannon, and Fieldcrest, among others.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Iconix Canada.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">In June 2013, the Company contributed substantially all rights to its wholly-owned and controlled brands in Canada into two entities: Ico Brands L.P. (&#8220;Ico Brands&#8221;) and Iconix Canada L.P. (&#8220;Ico Canada,&#8221; and together with Ico Brands, &#8220;Iconix Canada&#8221;). Shortly thereafter, through their acquisitions of limited partnership and general partnership interests, Buffalo International ULC and its affiliates purchased a 50% interest in Iconix Canada.&nbsp;&nbsp;In July 2017, the Company purchased from Buffalo its 50% interest in Iconix Canada for $19.0 million plus 50% of the net asset value of Iconix Canada (estimated to be approximately $2.0 million), increasing the Company&#8217;s ownership to 100%.&nbsp;&nbsp;Iconix Canada has many DTR licenses including London Fog at The Bay as well as a wide range of licenses for key brands such as Ecko Unltd., Danskin, Rampage, Zoo York, Umbro, Fieldcrest, Royal Velvet, and Waverly. </font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Umbro China.<font style="font-style:normal;">  </font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">In July 2016, the Company executed an agreement with MH Umbro International Co. Limited (&#8220;MHMC&#8221;) to sell up to an aggregate 50% interest in a newly registered company in Hong Kong, which holds the Umbro intellectual property in respect of the Greater China territory, of which, at that time, the Company received $2.5 million in cash from MHMC for a 5% interest in Umbro China. </font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;color:#000000;">In July 2019, pursuant to the operating agreement, the Company reacquired the 5% ownership interest in Umbro China from MHMC, its joint venture partner, for approximately $1.3 million.&nbsp;&nbsp;As a result of this transaction, the Company now maintains 100% ownership interest in Umbro China.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="text-decoration:underline;">International Joint Ventures</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The formation and administration of international joint ventures have been a central and ongoing component of our business since 2008. The Company established and maintains the following international joint ventures: Iconix Europe, Iconix India, Iconix Australia, Iconix Southeast Asia, Iconix Israel, Iconix Middle East, and Danskin China. The Company&#8217;s primary purpose in forming international joint ventures has been to bring its brands to market more quickly and efficiently, generating greater short- and long-term value from its IP.&nbsp;&nbsp;This approach enabled its brands to more rapidly increase licensing revenue, market share and profitability than what the Company believes it could have achieved on its own. </p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">To get what we believe are best-in-class local partners to invest in and represent the Company&#8217;s brands in their respective territories, the Company offers its partner the ability to buy equity interests in the IP. These equity interests provide the Company&#8217;s partners with the necessary incentive to devote management time and resources to the brands. By leveraging the partners&#8217; local market expertise, retail relationships, wholesale networks, business contacts and staff, the Company has significantly grown licensing royalties in key global markets and maintained stricter enforcement against counterfeit products. As these businesses in each territory reach sufficient scale to support the Company&#8217;s full business structure of brand management, marketing, licensing, acquisitions and finance, the Company may consider acquiring control or full ownership of the joint ventures, where possible, as was the case in Latin America in 2014, in China in 2015 and Canada in 2017.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Iconix Europe.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">In December 2009, the Company&#160;contributed substantially all rights to its wholly-owned brands in all member states and candidate states of the European Union,</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> and certain other European countries, to Iconix Europe, a then newly formed wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company.&#160;Shortly thereafter, an investment group led by Albion Equity Partners LLC, purchased a 50% interest in Iconix Europe for $4 million through</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> Brand Investments Vehicle Group 3 Limited (&#8220;BIV&#8221;). Also, as part of this transaction, Iconix Europe entered into a multi-year brand management and services agreement with The Licensing Company to&#160;assist in developing, exploiting, marketing and licensing t</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">he contributed brands in the European territory.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In January 2014, the Company consented to the purchase of BIV&#8217;s 50% ownership interest in Iconix Europe by Global Brands Group Asia Limited, formerly known as LF Asia Limited (&#8220;GBG&#8221;), in exchange for $1.5 million from GBG. In addition, the Company acquired an additional 1% equity interest in Iconix Europe from GBG thereby increasing the Company&#8217;s ownership in Iconix Europe to a controlling 51% interest. GBG is also our joint venture partner in Iconix SE Asia. </p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Iconix Europe has multiple DTR partnerships including Danskin with Go Sport and Danskin, Starter, Joe Boxer, Zoo York and London Fog with S-Group/Prisma as well as a wide range of licenses in multiple territories for key brands such as Ocean Pacific, Ecko Unltd., Rocawear, Cannon, and Waverly. </p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Iconix India. <font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">In May 2012, the Company contributed substantially all rights to its wholly-owned and controlled brands in India to Imaginative Brand Developers Private Limited, now known as Iconix Lifestyle India Private Limited (&#8220;Iconix India&#8221;), a then newly formed subsidiary of the Company. Shortly thereafter, Reliance Brands Limited (&#8220;Reliance&#8221;), purchased a 50% interest in Iconix India for $6.0 million. Reliance is an affiliate of Reliance Industries Limited, one of India&#8217;s largest private sector enterprises.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Iconix India has signed many long-term licensing partnerships with some of the largest retailing groups in India including Future Group, and Arvind and Aditya Birla Nuvo and has licensed brands such as Ecko Unltd., London Fog, Umbro, Ed Hardy and Cannon.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Iconix Australia.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">In September 2013, the Company contributed substantially all rights to its wholly-owned and controlled brands in Australia and New Zealand (the &#8220;Australia Territory&#8221;) to Iconix Australia through an exclusive, royalty-free perpetual master license agreement with Iconix Australia. Shortly thereafter, Pac Brands USA, Inc. (&#8220;Pac Brands USA&#8221;) purchased a 50% interest in Iconix Australia for $7.2 million from the Company to assist the Company in developing, exploiting, marketing and licensing the Company&#8217;s brands in the Australia Territory.&nbsp;&nbsp;In July 2018, the Company purchased an additional 5% ownership interest in Iconix Australia, effectively increasing the Company&#8217;s ownership interest in Iconix Australia to 55%.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Iconix Australia licenses many brands in the territory including Cannon, Ecko Unltd., Mossimo, Starter, Umbro, Zoo York, Fieldcrest, and Waverly.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Iconix Israel.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">In November 2013, the Company contributed substantially all rights to its wholly-owned and controlled brands in the State of Israel and the geographical regions of the West Bank and the Gaza Strip (together, the &#8220;Israel Territory&#8221;) to Iconix Israel LLC (&#8220;Iconix Israel&#8221;), a then newly formed subsidiary of the Company through an exclusive, royalty-free perpetual master license agreement with Iconix Israel. Shortly thereafter, M.G.S. Sports Trading Limited (&#8220;MGS&#8221;) purchased a 50% interest in Iconix Israel for approximately $3.4 million to assist the Company in developing, exploiting, marketing and licensing the Company&#8217;s brands in the Israel Territory.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">MGS and its affiliated companies, have licenses for Umbro, Joe Boxer, OP and Starter, which they distribute through their vast wholesale network and through its Mega Sport stores. Iconix Israel also includes a license with Brill Fashion for Lee Cooper.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Iconix Southeast Asia.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">In October 2013, the Company contributed substantially all rights to its wholly-owned and controlled brands in Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, Vietnam, Cambodia, Laos, Brunei, Myanmar and East Timor (together, the &#8220;Southeast Asia Territory&#8221;) to Lion Network Limited (&#8220;Iconix SE Asia&#8221;), a then newly formed subsidiary of the Company through an exclusive, royalty-free perpetual master license agreement with Iconix SE Asia. Shortly thereafter, GBG purchased a 50% interest in Iconix SE Asia for $10 million to assist the Company in developing, exploiting, marketing and licensing the Company&#8217;s brands in the Southeast Asia Territory.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In June 2014, the Company amended Iconix SE Asia by contributing substantially all rights to its wholly-owned and controlled brands in the territory of South Korea, and the Company&#8217;s Marc Ecko Cut&#160;&amp; Sew, Ecko Unltd., Zoo York, Ed Hardy and Sharper Image brands in the European Union and Turkey, in each case, to Iconix SE Asia. In return, GBG agreed to pay the Company $15.9 million.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">During September 2014, the Iconix SE Asia territory was further amended to include China, Macau, Hong Kong and Taiwan for the Umbro and Lee Cooper marks. In respect of its 50% interest in the joint venture, GBG agreed to pay the Company $21.5 million. In December 2015, the Company purchased GBG&#8217;s effective 50% interest in the Umbro and Lee Cooper marks in Greater China for $24.7 million. Iconix SE Asia has licensed many key brands in the Southeast Asia Territory including Joe Boxer, Cannon, Ecko Unltd., Ed Hardy, Lee Cooper, Mossimo, Starter, Zoo York, Umbro, Charisma and others.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">9</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Iconix Middle East and North Africa.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">In December 2014, the Company contributed substantially all rights to its wholly-owned</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> and controlled brands in the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Jordan, Egypt, Pakistan, Uganda, Yemen, Iraq, Azerbaijan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Lebanon, Tunisia, Libya, Algeria, Morocco, Cameroon, Gabon, Mauritania, Ivory </font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">Coast, Nigeria and Senegal (the &#8220;MENA Territory&#8221;) to Iconix MENA LTD (&#8220;Iconix MENA&#8221;), a then newly formed subsidiary of the Company through an exclusive, royalty-free perpetual master license agreement with Iconix MENA. Shortly thereafter, GBG, purchased a</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> 50% interest in Iconix MENA for $18.8 million to assist the Company in developing, exploiting, marketing and licensing the Company&#8217;s brands in the MENA Territory.&nbsp;&nbsp;In December 2016, the Company irrevocably exercised its right to acquire an additional 5% e</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">quity interest in Iconix MENA and increase the Company&#8217;s ownership interest to 55%.&nbsp;&nbsp;Such acquisition closed in February 2017.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Iconix Middle East has licensed many brands in the MENA Territory including Cannon, Ecko Unltd., Fieldcrest, Starter, Umbro, Zoo York, and Waverly and a substantial DTR license with Landmark Group for Lee Cooper.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Danskin China.<font style="font-style:normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">In October 2016, the Company entered into an agreement with Li-Ning Company Limited to sell up to a 50% interest (and no less than a 30% interest) in Danskin China, which holds the Danskin trademarks and related assets in respect of mainland China and Macau. As a result of disruptions caused in the People&#8217;s Republic of China, the Company has agreed to extend the date of LiNing&#8217;s purchase of the equity interest in Danskin China until June 30, 2020. </font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Diamond Icon LLC.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">In March 2013, the Company, via Iconix Luxembourg Holdings SARL, entered into a joint venture agreement with Albion Agencies Ltd, an English limited company, in which the Company purchased a 51% interest in Diamond Icon Ltd, also an English limited company. Diamond Icon was established to design, develop and facilitate the supply of apparel, footwear and sports equipment for the Umbro brand; a service the wholesale licensees depend upon, which was previously provided by the former owner, Nike. The apparel, footwear and accessories developed by Diamond Icon for Umbro are distributed by wholesale licensees of the Umbro brand around the world.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Starter China.<font style="font-style:normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</font><font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">In March 2018, the Company entered into an agreement with Photosynthesis Holdings, Co. Ltd. to sell up to no less than a 50% interest and up to a total of 60% interest in Starter China, which holds the Starter trademarks and related assets in respect of the Greater China territory.&nbsp;&nbsp;As a result of disruptions in the People&#8217;s Republic of China, the Company has agreed to extend the date of PHL&#8217;s first purchase of the equity interest in Starter China until June 30, 2020.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Lee Cooper China.<font style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;In June 2018, the Company entered into an agreement with POS Lee Cooper HK Co. Ltd. To sell up to no less than a 50% interest and up to a total of 60% interest in Lee Cooper China, which holds the Lee Cooper trademarks and related assets in respect of the Greater China territory.&nbsp;&nbsp;PLC&#8217;s purchase of the equity interest in Lee Cooper China is expected to occur over a two-year period commencing on January 15, 2024. </font></p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_Hlk503446942"></a>Marcy Media</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">On November 12, 2019, the Company sold certain intellectual property assets to Roc Nation LLC and its holding of membership interests in Marcy Media Holdings LLC to MM Holdings Acquisition LLC for $15.0 million and mutual releases of all existing claims between the parties. The Company also recorded an investment impairment of $17.0 million in the third quarter of 2019 based on the estimated value that would be realized from the sale of the entity.</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Licensing Strategy</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company&#8217;s principal business strategy is to maximize the value of its brands by entering into strategic license agreements with best-in-class licensees that are responsible for designing, manufacturing and distributing the licensed products. Through our licensing business model, we have substantially eliminated inventory risk and reduced the operating exposure associated with traditional fully vertically integrated businesses, thereby resulting in attractive cash flows and&#160;operating margins.&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company has over 430 licenses and has benefited from the model&#8217;s scalability, which enables the Company to leverage its existing infrastructure to support new business and brands. A key objective of the Company is to capitalize on its brand management expertise and relationships to build and maintain a diversified portfolio of consumer brands that generate revenues. Through our international partnerships, we have successfully built a vast network of licensees around the world.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company licenses its brands across a broad range of product categories, including fashion apparel, footwear, accessories, sportswear, home furnishings and d&#233;cor, and beauty and fragrance. The Company seeks licensees with the ability to produce and sell quality products in their licensed categories and to meet and exceed minimum sales and royalty payment thresholds. </p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company maintains DTR and traditional wholesale licenses. Typically, in a DTR license, the Company grants rights which may be exclusive to one of its brands to a single national retailer for a broad range of product categories. DTR licenses provide retailers with proprietary rights to national brands at&#160;favorable economics.&#160;In a traditional wholesale license, the Company grants certain rights to a specific brand to a single or small group of related product categories to a wholesale supplier, who is permitted to sell licensed products to multiple stores within an approved distribution channel. For example, the Company licenses the Charisma brand in the United States to numerous wholesale suppliers for sale and distribution primarily to department and specialty stores.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">10</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company&#8217;s licenses typically require the licensee to pay the Company royalties based upon net sales with guaranteed minimum royalties. The Company&#8217;s licenses also typically require the licensees to</font><font style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> pay to the Company certain minimum amounts for the advertising and marketing of the respective licensed brands. As of January&#160;1, 20</font><font style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">20</font><font style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">, the Company and its joint ventures had a contractual right to receive </font><font style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">approximately</font><font style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> $</font><font style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">40</font><font style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">0</font><font style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> million of aggregate minimum li</font><font style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">censing revenue through the balance of their current licenses, excluding any renewals.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company believes that coordination of&#160;brand presentation across product categories is critical to maintaining the strength and integrity of its brands. Accordingly, the Company typically maintains the right in its&#160;licenses to preview and approve all products, packaging and other presentations of the licensed mark. Moreover, in many of its licenses, prior to each season, representatives of the Company supply licensees with trend guidance as to the &#8220;look and feel&#8221; of the current trends for the season, including colors, fabrics, silhouettes and an overall style sensibility, and then work with licensees to coordinate the licensed products across the categories to maintain the cohesiveness of the brand&#8217;s overall presentation in the market place. Thereafter, the Company obtains and approves (or objects and requires modification to) product and packaging provided by each licensee on an on-going basis.&nbsp;&nbsp;In addition, the Company communicates with its licensees throughout the year to obtain and review reporting of sales and calculation and payment of royalties.</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_Hlk503446971"></a>Marketing</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company believes marketing is a critical element in maximizing brand value to its consumers, licensees and to the Company.
